summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the detailed final voting map from its Extraordinary General Meeting held on April 27, 2026. The sole resolution was an amendment to Article 1 of the bylaws to change the company's legal domicile to São Paulo, Brazil. The filing discloses individual shareholder votes but does not involve any merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, activist campaign, or other special-situation event. It is a routine post-meeting disclosure under Brazilian CVM Resolution No. 81/22, akin to a domestic Form 8-K Item 5.07. No deal terms or special-situation mechanics are present.
